source.paraphrase: 32-bit mixed PMU control/status at0xffd80000. Read-only MB_Sleep bit16 distinguishes active(0) from sleep(1). Dont_Sleep bit0 drives wake while sleep and interrupts disabled. No state-reservation, lock, synchronisation bound or no-wake interval is specified by this register entry.

assessment.ram_probe: PSU/AP0 mrd fixed RAM0xffdc0050 twice; no sleep acquisition or lifetime proof. Do not run as a new safety-qualified probe.
assessment.restore: Selects PMU debug target, stop->suspended->r0->download->resume. This intentionally alters execution and depends on a working debug path; no arbitrary-hang guarantee.
assessment.guard_probe: PSU/AP0 request writes and record reads; existing physical scope is historical, not a generic sleep-status observer.

open: Master access/security and debug side effects for a newly scoped status-only observer need exact route proof.
Read-only status reports a state, not continuous exclusion of wake/reset/exception.
Independent recovery from stuck MMIO remains unqualified.
next_safe_step: Offline explicit observer-only contract and fail-closed race/lifetime admission predicate, with no RAM access or deployment executor.
